description: Schema template for real auditor data collection — 5 auditors (HUMAN_01, HUMAN_02, GPT, CLAUDE, GROK) × 8 claims (C01-C08) = 40 classifications. Defines label_schema (SUPPORTED/PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), C08 gate threshold (Krippendorff alpha >= 0.667), and inter-rater reliability computation trigger.
function: Schema template for real auditor data collection — 5 auditors × 8 claims = 40 classifications, C08 gate, Krippendorff alpha computation trigger

inputs.name: classification_matrix_schema_v1.json
inputs.description: Governance template — fill in classifications after owner confirms CANONICAL_v1

inputs.name: auditor_id
inputs.description: One of: HUMAN_01, HUMAN_02, GPT, CLAUDE, GROK

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: One of: SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

outputs.name: auditors
outputs.description: List of 5 auditor definitions (id, type, blind flag)

outputs.name: label_schema
outputs.description: Valid label values, confidence range, required fields per classification entry

outputs.name: classifications
outputs.description: 40-row classification matrix (one per auditor × claim pair)

outputs.name: computed_metrics
outputs.description: Placeholder for Krippendorff alpha, n_auditors, n_claims, inter_rater_verdict

outputs.name: pipeline_log
outputs.description: Audit trail timestamps for each pipeline phase

public_api.name: classification_matrix_schema_v1.json
public_api.description: Load and read the schema template. Fill in the 'classifications' array with one entry per (auditor × claim) pair. After all 40 entries are filled, compute Krippendorff alpha and evaluate the C08 gate.
